Usage: yantra research [options] <topic>

Deep, multi-hop research on a topic, returned as a long-form Brief.

Arguments:
  topic                          topic to research from web sources

Options:
  --provider <name>              agent model provider
  --model <id>                   provider-scoped model id
  --thinking <level>             provider reasoning level
  --auth-secret <ref>            runtime model-key secret reference
  --max-duration <duration>      whole-run wall-clock duration
  --max-tokens <n>               cumulative provider token ceiling
  --tool-timeout <duration>      timeout for one tool call
  --tool-retries <n>             retries after an identical tool failure
  --confirm-timeout <duration>   maximum live consent wait
  --no-llm                       force the deterministic no-model path
  --no-screenshots               no screenshots this run (vision assist and saved captures)
  --browser <source>             browser source for this invocation (auto, managed, or system)
  --browser-path <path>          absolute path to a Chrome or Chromium executable
  --no-browse                    run research without the read-only browser for this run
  --json                         shorthand for --format json (default: false)
  --depth <hops>                 number of research hops (1-3) (choices: "1", "2", "3", default: "2")
  --max-sources <n>              maximum sources to gather (default: "24")
  --detail <level>               terminal disclosure level (choices: "overview", "standard", "full", default: "standard")
  --format <format>              output format sent to stdout (choices: "terminal", "md", "html", "json", default: "terminal")
  --length <length>              final synthesis length budget (choices: "short", "medium", "long", default: "long")
  --open                         open the generated brief.html in the default browser
  --template <name|tag|path>     render the result with a saved name, tag, or Markdown template path
  --no-color                     disable ANSI color output
  --search-provider <provider>   search provider (default: auto walks tavily -> brave -> duckduckgo) (choices: "auto", "google", "duckduckgo", "brave",
                                 "tavily")
  --max-llm-calls <n>            maximum LLM calls across the deterministic run
  --per-query-limit <n>          search results to consider per query (default: "6")
  --fetch-timeout <ms>           per-fetch timeout in ms (default: "8000")
  --pipeline-timeout <duration>  deterministic loop wall-clock timeout (for example 3m) (default: "3m")
  -h, --help                     display help for command
